name: fritzbox-mcp-server
description: Control your AVM FRITZ!Box router through Claude - manage devices, WiFi, network settings, and parental controls with natural language
long_description:
# FRITZ!Box MCP Server

A secure Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for interacting with AVM FRITZ!Box routers through AI assistants like Claude.

## Key Features

* **Runtime-driven & Model-agnostic**: Works with all FRITZ!Box models and firmware versions
* **Automatic Discovery**: Discovers capabilities dynamically from your FRITZ!Box
* **Secure by Design**: Credentials never leave your local machine
* **Time-Delayed Actions**: Schedule network changes using at/cron (unique feature no GUI offers)
* **Comprehensive Coverage**: Access to all TR-064 services (devices, WiFi, parental controls, VoIP, smart home)

## Security First

**Your FRITZ!Box credentials NEVER leave your machine.**

This MCP server runs entirely locally. Credentials are stored in a local `.env` file and only used to communicate with your FRITZ!Box on your local network. The AI assistant receives only the results of API calls, never your credentials.

## Example Use Cases

* "What devices are connected to my WiFi?"
* "Show me my current internet connection status"
* "Analyze my network health"
* "Block Kevin's Nintendo Switch in 20 minutes" (time-delayed parental control)
* "Prioritize bandwidth for my work laptop"
* "List all smart home devices"

privacy_policies.title: Privacy Policy
privacy_policies.description: All communication stays local. No data is sent to external servers. Credentials are stored locally only.

_meta.config_instructions:
# Configuration Required

Before using this extension, you must create a `.env` file with your FRITZ!Box credentials:

**Global config (recommended):**
```
mkdir -p ~/.config/fritzbox-mcp-server
```

Create `~/.config/fritzbox-mcp-server/.env` with:
```
FRITZ_HOST=fritz.box
FRITZ_PORT=49000
FRITZ_USERNAME=your-username
FRITZ_PASSWORD=your-password
```

**Security:** Set proper permissions: `chmod 600 ~/.config/fritzbox-mcp-server/.env`

**FRITZ!Box User Permissions:** The user account must have **FRITZ!Box-Einstellungen** permission enabled in your FRITZ!Box web interface under System → FRITZ!Box-Benutzer.
